title: The scalar coefficient comparison is its specified single-sheaf comparison
statement: For rings A,B in Type(u+1), a ring homomorphism phi:A -> B and a morphism f:Z -> W of schemes in universe u, upperStarSingleCoefficientIso A f evaluated at scalarCoefficientSheafPullbackIso phi f equals scalarCoefficientPullbackIso phi f. Both sides use the same exact-derived inverse-image comparison, single-functor comparison and single image of the ordinary scalar coefficient iso.

source.place: Tags 0G7E and 07A4; unchanged canonical single-complex comparisons.

proof.text: Unfold the two named isomorphisms. Both apply the exact-derived and single-functor comparisons, then the single image of the restriction/pullback iso on the B-unit followed by restriction of the inverse unit comparison. Thus their defining expressions are identical, and reflexivity proves the equality. This is the original proved theorem moved unchanged to a smaller module.
